title: From the field to the decision, and a system that can act on it.
lead: Different assignments use different methods. The discipline underneath is consistent: understand the real system, structure the evidence, test the alternatives and design for implementation.
hint: Scroll to move through the five stages
statement: Understand the real system, structure the evidence, test alternatives, and design for implementation.

stages.label: Reality
stages.detail: Field observation, consultation, document review, institutional context.

stages.label: Evidence
stages.line: Find the signal, then structure it.
stages.detail: Survey design, data collection, cost estimation, gap assessment.
stages.figureLabel: units of primary evidence in one green-transition study: 400 firms, 120 key informant interviews, 8 focus groups

stages.label: Model
stages.line: Build the analysis the decision actually needs.
stages.detail: ENPV/FNPV, EIRR/FIRR, benefit-cost ratios, scenario and sensitivity analysis.
stages.chartLabel: Net cash flow by year, Y0–Y15

stages.label: Decision
stages.detail: Options analysis, affordability, institutional capacity, risk.

stages.label: System
stages.line: Design something that can act on it.
stages.detail: Costed phasing, financing structure, M&E framework, delivery arrangements.
